title: Orsen and the Crown
premise: When the crown of Veyra declares a kingdom-wide hunt for magic-bearers, Sable Montrose, the last active member of the Charmwrights' Guild, is betrayed by a customer and dragged before the Inquisitor's court. There he discovers the hunt is a cover for Prince Aldric's true scheme: to drain the last dragon, Emberveil, whose dying fire sustains the covenant that keeps the fae realm sealed. Sable escapes with the help of Maren, an inquisitor who secretly carries the gift herself, and together they seek the scattered fragments of the broken covenant — hidden in guild relics, forbidden memories, and Sable's own suppressed childhood. As Sable recovers his erased memories of the night the covenant shattered twelve years ago, he learns his own guildmaster helped break it, trading the dragons' trust for the guild's survival. In the climax at Emberveil's mountain, Sable must choose between restoring the covenant (which will cost him every memory he has rebuilt) or letting it die and unleashing both realms' chaos; he offers his memories willingly, reforging the bond, and wakes with nothing but a dragon-scale charm and a stranger named Maren who promises to help him remember who he was.
about_author: W. M. Almeida is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval charters before turning to fiction full-time. They live near the coast with two cats and an ever-growing collection of antique keys.

chapters.title: The Charm Seller's Winter
chapters.summary: Sable Montrose sells a luck-charm to a nervous noblewoman in the frost-bound city of Corvane, hiding his gift beneath mundane trade. His POV establishes the outlawed-magic world, the guild's ruin, and his quiet loneliness. Emotional beat: weary vigilance — he survives by being small and forgettable.

chapters.title: The Proclamation
chapters.summary: Heralds read the crown's Edict of Cleansing: all gifted persons must surrender for 'curing.' Sable watches from a crowd as a street-singer is seized. His POV; fear curdles into resolve as he burns his ledger and prepares to flee. Beat: the safe life ends.

chapters.title: The Customer Who Knew
chapters.summary: The noblewoman returns with Inquisitor Hale's men; she marked Sable's charm as genuine. A rooftop chase through Corvane's bell-towers ends with Sable cornered — until Maren Vale, a young inquisitor, quietly lets him slip away. Dual tension, Sable's POV. Beat: betrayal, then an inexplicable mercy.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Guildhall
chapters.summary: Sable shelters in the ruined Charmwrights' Guildhall and finds his dead guildmaster's sealed letter, warning that the covenant between realms is failing and naming three relic-keys. Sable's POV. Beat: grief transmuted into purpose — he inherits a mission he never asked for.

chapters.title: The Inquisitor's Doubt
chapters.summary: Maren's POV: she hides her own faint gift while hunting others, interrogating prisoners whose confessions feel scripted by Prince Aldric's spymaster. She realizes the hunt targets something larger than stray magicians. Beat: complicity and dread — she decides to find Sable first.

chapters.title: The Relic of Salt
chapters.summary: Sable retrieves the first key from a drowned chapel in the tidal flats, guided by the letter, and is ambushed by Hale's wardens. Maren intervenes, revealing her gift; uneasy alliance forms. Sable's POV. Beat: reluctant trust kindled under fire.

chapters.title: What the Fire Remembers
chapters.summary: The salt relic shows Sable a vision of Emberveil, the last dragon, chained beneath Mount Kaelen — and a hooded figure breaking the covenant twelve years ago. Sable's POV. Beat: horror and recognition; the figure wears a guildmaster's ring like his own.

chapters.title: Road Through Thornhollow
chapters.summary: Traveling toward the second relic, Sable and Maren shelter in a village where children still whisper old charms. A warden raid forces them to defend the villagers, exposing Maren publicly. Alternating POV. Beat: warmth of community, price of open defiance.

chapters.title: The Prince's Court
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV chapter: the prince explains to Hale why the dragon must die — the covenant's magic feeds the fae realm, which he blames for his mother's madness. He orders the mountain sealed. Beat: chilling sympathy; the villain believes himself a savior.

chapters.title: The Relic of Bone
chapters.summary: In the catacombs of Thornhollow's abbey, Sable claims the second key guarded by a bone-warden construct. The trial nearly kills him; Maren's untrained magic saves them both. Sable's POV. Beat: growing partnership, deepening mystery about his own past.

chapters.title: Twelve Years Missing
chapters.summary: Maren notices gaps in Sable's memory — no childhood, no guild apprenticeship before age fourteen. Under a truth-charm, fragments surface: fire, screaming, a hand erasing his mind. Sable's POV. Beat: vertigo of self-doubt — who broke the covenant?

chapters.title: Hale's Net
chapters.summary: Inquisitor Hale corners them using Maren's captured partner as bait. Maren surrenders to buy Sable time; Hale, conflicted, imprisons rather than executes her. Maren's POV. Beat: sacrifice and the cost of loyalty to a corrupt institution.

chapters.title: The Third Key Refuses
chapters.summary: Alone, Sable reaches the third relic — hidden inside his own guildmaster's grave — and it rejects him: the final key is memory itself. He must reclaim what was taken. Sable's POV. Beat: despair turning to terrible resolve.

chapters.title: The Unbinding
chapters.summary: Sable performs a forbidden rite on his own mind, shattering the memory-seal. Twelve years return: his guildmaster broke the covenant to save the guild from Aldric's father, and made child-Sable forget so he could one day repair it. Sable's POV. Beat: devastating clarity — his beloved mentor was both betrayer and penitent.

chapters.title: Prison of Quiet Bells
chapters.summary: Maren endures interrogation, concealing the covenant's secrets while Aldric's spymaster probes her mind. She turns her captor's own truth-spell against him, learning the dragon-draining ritual's date. Maren's POV. Beat: quiet courage sharpening into escape.

chapters.title: Breaking Maren Out
chapters.summary: Sable infiltrates the Inquisition tower with the third key's power over memory, erasing his own trail. He frees Maren and other gifted prisoners, who join as unlikely allies. Sable's POV. Beat: the loner becomes a leader; hope rekindled.

chapters.title: March to Kaelen
chapters.summary: The ragged company races Aldric's army to the mountain through blizzard and fae-touched wilds where the thinning covenant leaks strange wonders. Losses mount; a young prisoner dies holding the line. Alternating POV. Beat: camaraderie forged in grief.

chapters.title: Emberveil Wakes
chapters.summary: In the dragon's cavern, Emberveil tests Sable with visions of every broken promise between realms. Sable offers not excuses but the truth of his guild's betrayal. The dragon relents, showing him the reforging rite — and its price. Sable's POV. Beat: awe, humility, acceptance.

chapters.title: The Draining Begins
chapters.summary: Aldric's ritual engines pierce the mountain; dragon-fire gutters as his mages siphon it. Maren leads the defenders in a delaying battle through the tunnels while Sable reaches the covenant-stone. Alternating POV. Beat: desperate, losing fight against time.

chapters.title: The Choice at the Stone
chapters.summary: At the covenant-stone, Sable confronts Aldric, who sees his mother's face in the fae visions and wavers — then hardens. To complete the rite, Sable must feed the stone his memories of everyone he loves. Sable's POV. Beat: the theme made flesh — power demands what we are.

chapters.title: Covenant Reforged
chapters.summary: Sable speaks his memories into the stone as Maren holds Aldric's forces at bay; the dragon-fire surges, the realms rebalance, and Aldric, shown his mother's true fate by the restored covenant, calls off the draining in shattered remorse. Sable collapses empty. Climax. Beat: sacrifice fulfilled.

chapters.title: A Stranger Named Maren
chapters.summary: Weeks later, magic is licensed anew and the guild re-founded. Sable wakes with no past but a dragon-scale charm warm in his palm; Maren finds him and begins telling him their story, promising to help him remember. Resolution. Beat: bittersweet renewal — identity can be rebuilt, and love outlasts memory.
